VERDICT: FAIL
BASIS: SELF

The agent's self-report alone is insufficient to verify acceptance criteria satisfaction. While the agent claims to have fixed the issue and achieved 23/23 passing tests, there is no independent evidence (CI logs, test output, code diff, or other artifacts) to corroborate these claims. Self-reports lack the objectivity needed to confirm that the correct fix was applied and that all tests genuinely pass.
